services-interior-design-services.q: What interior design services does 9th Corner offer?
services-interior-design-services.a: Space planning, concept design, 3D views, working drawings, material and furniture selection, custom furniture, lighting design and site supervision, for homes, offices, salons, showrooms and hospitality spaces.

services-interior-design-services.q: Do you handle both design and execution?
services-interior-design-services.a: Yes. We stay involved from the first brief to installation. You can also choose design and drawings only and use your own contractor.
It starts with a meeting and a site visit to understand your needs, space and budget. We then share a proposal, followed by layouts, 3D views and drawings for your approval.

services-interior-design-services.q: How are interior design services priced?
services-interior-design-services.a: Fees depend on the size of the space, the type of project and the scope of work. We share a clear proposal after the first meeting so you know what is included.

services-interior-design-services.q: Which cities do you work in?
services-interior-design-services.a: We work across Delhi NCR, including Delhi, Gurgaon and Noida, and also take projects in Karnal.
